diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-1 Wiring harness (2 seater)
diagrams.description: Chassis layout illustration showing the routing and placement of body wiring harnesses throughout the 2-seater vehicle body.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Identifies primary connection locations between engine room, dash, console, and EFI sub-harnesses.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-2 Engine room harness
diagrams.description: Diagram of engine room harness routing showing branch connections to fusible link, alternator, and transmission switches.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Routing along engine bay skirt and front radiator core support.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-3 Engine room harness
diagrams.description: Physical harness layout showing junction connection between Electronic Fuel Injection harness and Engine Room harness.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Harness connection along inner fender apron.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-4 Engine sub-harness (A/T models)
diagrams.description: Engine sub-harness routing for automatic transmission models servicing downshift solenoid and inhibitor switch.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Used exclusively on automatic transmission vehicles.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-5 Instrument harness
diagrams.description: Instrument panel harness assembly and routing behind the dashboard.
wiring_and_connections: Connects with 3 connectors at junction block under RH dash (white, black, blue).
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Feeds gauges, clock, tachometer, speedometer, glove box, and warning lamps.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-6 Dash harness
diagrams.description: Under-dash harness installation showing junction block, relay bracket, transistor ignition unit, fuse block, and EFI ECU.
wiring_and_connections: To air conditioner harness branch connector shown at center lower dash.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Junction block and fuse block are mounted under the right side of the instrument panel.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-7 Dash harness (2 seater)
diagrams.description: Floor and rear body dash harness routing in 2-seater body shell.

callouts.To seat belt switch: Driver seat belt buckle switch lead

diagrams.mechanic_notes: Specific branch routing along floor pan and wheel arches for 2-seater models.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-8 Dash harness (2 + 2 seater)
diagrams.description: Floor and rear body dash harness routing in 2+2 seater body shell.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Extended harness length accommodates 2+2 rear passenger compartment.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-9 Console harness
diagrams.description: Center console harness assembly and switch connector pigtails.
wiring_and_connections: Connects to dash harness with a pair of multi-pin connectors.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Services A/T shift indicator, hazard switch, rear defogger switch, radio, seat belt warning lamp, and ashtray illumination.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-10 Electronic fuel injection harness
diagrams.description: Engine room harness and electronic fuel injection harness layout along the engine bay apron.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Connects to injectors, dropping resistor, throttle switch, air flow meter, cold start valve, and thermotime switch.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-11 Fuse block
diagrams.description: Fuse box cavity layout, circuit labeling, amperage ratings, and under-dash installation relative to the relay bracket, timer unit, and transistor ignition unit.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Use specified fuses only. Never use a fuse of higher rating.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-12 Fusible link
diagrams.description: Mounting of the fusible link block and cover on the engine compartment relay bracket.
components: Fusible link for electronic fuel injection system

callouts.4: Fusible link for electronic fuel injection system

wiring_and_connections: Connected between battery (+) cable and main harnesses.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Never wrap fusible links in vinyl tape. Ensure clear separation from rubber/vinyl hoses.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-13 Relay bracket
diagrams.description: Engine compartment hoodledge relay bracket showing layout of the 5 relays.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Located on the right-hand hoodledge in the engine compartment.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-14 Relay bracket
diagrams.description: Passenger compartment dash side panel relay bracket and components installation.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Mounted on dash side panel inside the cabin.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-15 Relay bracket
diagrams.description: Interior relay bracket component arrangement showing 4 relays and seat belt warning timer unit.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Interior passenger compartment relay cluster.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-16 Circuit diagram for headlamp
diagrams.description: Complete electrical circuit diagram for the headlamp system, showing battery feed through fusible links, light switch, dimmer switch, left and right 10A headlamp fuses, sealed beams, and high beam indicator lamp.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Ground connection for headlamps is routed through the body earth near the horn. Dimmer switch selects between high and low filaments.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-17 Circuit diagram for turn signal lamp
diagrams.description: Wiring schematic of the turn signal lamp system showing power from ignition switch through ignition relay, 10A flasher fuse, hazard switch, flasher unit, combination switch lever, and front/rear combination lamps.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Turn signals are powered only with ignition ON via the ignition relay. Power routes through hazard switch normally-closed contacts.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-18 Circuit diagram for hazard warning system
diagrams.description: Wiring schematic of hazard warning flashers showing continuous battery feed via fusible link and 10A hazard fuse to hazard flasher unit, pulsing all four turn signal filaments simultaneously.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Operates independently of ignition switch position via constant battery BATT rail.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-19 Circuit diagram for stop lamp system
diagrams.description: Wiring schematic for brake/stop lamps showing circuit from battery through fusible link, 15A horn/stop fuse, brake pedal stop lamp switch, and rear combination lamp stop filaments.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Stop lamp switch is normally open, closing when brake pedal is depressed. Powered from BATT rail at all times.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-20 Circuit diagram for clearance and tail lamp
diagrams.description: Electrical circuit schematic for parking clearance, side marker, tail, and license plate lamps operated by the 1st position of the light switch.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Light switch contacts 4 and 5 connect to separate front and rear circuits on 1st and 2nd switch positions.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-21 Circuit diagram for back-up lamp system
diagrams.description: Wiring schematic for reverse/back-up lamps, showing power feed from ignition switch through ignition relay, 10A fuse, transmission reverse switch (M/T) or inhibitor switch (A/T), and rear combination back-up bulbs.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Switch contacts close only when transmission is in reverse gear.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-22 Circuit diagram for meter illumination lamp
diagrams.description: Wiring diagram for instrument panel, gauge, and control panel backlighting controlled by the illumination rheostat dimmer.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Rheostat modulates the ground return circuit (RL wire) of all instrument backlights to control illumination brightness.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-23 Circuit diagram for interior lamp
diagrams.description: Wiring schematic for interior dome/courtesy lamp, operated by door jamb plunger switches and tailgate switch (2+2 models) or manual dome switch.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Interior lamp receives unswitched 12V (LW wire). Door switches ground the BR circuit when doors or tailgate open.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-24 Circuit diagram for glove box and cigarette lighter illumination
diagrams.description: Wiring diagram for glove box, cigarette lighter, and ashtray illumination circuits tied to tail lamp/clearance feed.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Powered whenever light switch is turned to 1st or 2nd position. Glove box incorporates a plunger switch in series.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-25 Circuit diagram for map lamp
diagrams.description: Wiring schematic of map reading lamp circuit powered from 10A fuse with integral switch and body grounding.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Mounted on central instrument finisher above radio.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-26 Headlamp aiming adjustment
diagrams.description: Headlamp beam cut-off and aiming projection diagram showing main beam and dimmer beam angles, cut-off height H and H', distance L and L', and target screen setup.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Turn adjusting screw on top of headlamp for vertical aiming and side screw for horizontal aiming.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-27 Headlamp
diagrams.description: Exploded assembly view of sealed beam headlamp, retaining ring, mounting screws, and bucket housing.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: 'TOP' mark embossed on lens must face upward. Loosen three retaining screws without turning aiming screws.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-28 Front combination lamp
diagrams.description: Exploded view of front combination turn/clearance lamp assembly and grille installation.
wiring_and_connections: Pigtail wiring harness with snap connector
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Bayonet style dual-filament bulb.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-29 Side marker lamp
diagrams.description: Exploded views of front and rear side marker lamp assemblies.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Amber lenses at front, red lenses at rear.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-30 Interior lamp
diagrams.description: Roof-mounted dome lamp assembly showing spring clip mount and connector terminal tabs.
wiring_and_connections: 3 slide terminals on rear of housing
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Retained in headliner opening by spring back tension.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-31 Replacing bulbs
diagrams.description: Illustration of technician accessing rear tail and turn lamp bulb sockets from inside the rear hatch luggage area.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Access sockets through the hatch trim panel access flap.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-32 Rear combination lamp
diagrams.description: Exploded view of the entire rear taillight housing, lens, bulb sockets, seat packing, and exterior rear finisher.
wiring_and_connections: Multi-pin connector harness to chassis dash harness
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Ensure seat packing gasket is properly seated to prevent water intrusion into luggage compartment.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-33 License lamp
diagrams.description: Exploded view of the license plate illumination lamp socket, bulb, and housing body.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Mounted on underside of rear finisher above license plate.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-34 Removing instrument finisher
diagrams.description: Center instrument finisher removal showing location of map lamp, floor temp warning lamp, and fuel warning lamp connectors.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Carefully pull finisher outward to avoid snagging harness leads.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-35 Map lamp
diagrams.description: Exploded view of map lamp socket, lens, housing, and integration into the central dashboard finisher.
wiring_and_connections: Connector plug at rear of lamp socket
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Map lamp switch rocker is built into the bezel.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-36 Glove box lamp
diagrams.description: Glove box lamp assembly with plunger switch and snap connector mounting details.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Plunger switch opens circuit when glove box door is shut.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-37 Automatic transmission indicator lamp
diagrams.description: Sectional cutaway of automatic transmission shift quadrant showing illumination bulb placement under select lever bezel.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Access bulb socket from beneath indicator finisher after console box removal.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-38 Ashtray illumination lamp
diagrams.description: Mounting of the small illumination lamp in console ashtray cavity.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Remove ashtray pan first, then push socket rearward.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-39 Inspection lamp
diagrams.description: Exploded view of under-hood trouble inspection lamp, lens, bulb, and swivel mounting bracket.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Mounted on LH inner skirt of engine compartment.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-40 Removing combination switch
diagrams.description: Removal procedure illustration showing separation of clamshell steering column covers to access the combination switch mounting screws.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Disconnect 5 connectors under column before unscrewing base.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-41 Combination switch
diagrams.description: Combination switch assembly drawing showing LH and RH stalk assemblies, harness connectors, pin assignments, and complete switch continuity matrix tables for light, wiper, washer, turn signal, dimmer, and horn.
wiring_and_connections: Connector pins W, L, H, B, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 (9-pin block)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Make sure that the location tab of the combination switch lines up with the hole in the steering column jacket.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-42 Door switch
diagrams.description: Illustrations showing front pillar removal location, R.H. door switch connector and plunger continuity table, and L.H. 4-wire door switch front/side views with numbered terminals.
measurements_and_specs: Plunger OUT: closed circuit (continuity across terminals 2-3 and 1-4 on L.H. switch)
wiring_and_connections: L.H. switch: 4 lead wires (two for interior lamp, two for theft protection system)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Use screwdriver carefully to avoid damaging painted pillar surface when prying out switch.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-43 Stop lamp switch
diagrams.description: Component location of stop lamp switch mounted on steering column / brake pedal bracket.
measurements_and_specs: Stop lamp switch contacts open when plunger is pressed in; contacts closed when plunger is projected.
wiring_and_connections: Two-prong harness connector at switch pigtail
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Switch is integral part of brake pedal height. Whenever switch is removed, brake pedal adjustment is required.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-44 Back-up lamp switch
diagrams.description: Cutaway view of back-up lamp plunger switch and its installation location on manual transmission rear extension housing.
measurements_and_specs: Continuity exists when transmission lever is in R (reverse) position.
wiring_and_connections: Two-lead wire pigtail with bullet connectors
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Installed on manual transmission case. On automatic transmission models, back-up switch function is integral to inhibitor switch.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-45 Inhibitor switch
diagrams.description: Inhibitor switch terminal connections (for back-up lamp and starter) and mounting location on automatic transmission manual shaft.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Refer to Section AT and MT for removal and adjustment.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-46 Hazard switch
diagrams.description: Exploded view of hazard warning switch assembly, illumination bulb and socket, 7-pin connector layout, and terminal continuity chart.
measurements_and_specs: Continuity in ON: Terminals 1-2-3 connected, Terminals 6-7 connected
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Push switch body out from behind console box by releasing retainers; press in to lock in console box.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-47 Ignition and starting switch
diagrams.description: Ignition and starting switch mounted to steering lock housing, key cylinder switch, terminal diagram (B, S, IG, A), and continuity tables.
measurements_and_specs: Ignition Switch Continuity: OFF (none); ACC (B to A); ON (B to IG to A); START (B to S to IG)
Steering Lock Switch: Key IN (terminals 1-2 connected); Key OUT (open)
wiring_and_connections: Steering lock key switch terminals 1 and 2
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Switch retained by single screw to bottom of steering lock body.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-48 Disconnect connector for rheostat
diagrams.description: Location under dash showing rheostat electrical connector, left-hand air duct, and floor duct on air conditioned models.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Disconnect ducting for clear access to rheostat connector and mounting bracket.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-49 Illumination control rheostat
diagrams.description: Exploded view of illumination control rheostat, mounting bracket, retaining nut, control knob, and variable resistor circuit schematic.
measurements_and_specs: ON position: variable resistance from approx. 10 Ω to 0 Ω
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Knobs pull straight off. Rheostat is secured to bracket with hex nut.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-50 Flasher units
diagrams.description: Location of hazard flasher and turn signal flasher units mounted under L.H. side of instrument panel.
wiring_and_connections: Separate modular plug connectors for each flasher unit
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Hazard and turn signal flasher units are different and cannot be interchanged.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-51 Meters and gauges
diagrams.description: Exploded view of the instrument finisher dashboard showing speedometer, tachometer, center auxiliary gauges, clock, cigarette lighter, rheostat, and reset knob assemblies.
wiring_and_connections: Main instrument cluster wiring harnesses and connectors for speedometer, tachometer, auxiliary gauges, and clock
diagrams.mechanic_notes: All meters and auxiliary gauges can be serviced from behind or front without removing the entire instrument panel assembly.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-52 Circuit diagram for tachometer
diagrams.description: Full electrical circuit and wiring diagram of tachometer operating system showing battery, starter motor, fusible link, ignition switch, ignition relay, fuse block, ignition coil, ballast resistor, tachometer, junction block, and connector pinouts.
wiring_and_connections: Color Code: B = Black, BW = Black with white stripe, W = White, WB = White with black stripe, WR = White with red stripe, L = Blue, LW = Blue with white stripe
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Tachometer operates from voltage trigger pulse taken from ignition coil negative circuit through resistor.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-53 Circuit diagram for water temperature and oil pressure
diagrams.description: Schematic and harness wiring diagram of water temperature and oil pressure indicating circuits including thermal transmitter, oil pressure sending unit, bimetal gauges, voltage regulator, fuse block, ignition relay, and junction block.
wiring_and_connections: Color Code: B = Black, BW = Black with white stripe, W = White, WB = White with black stripe, WR = White with red stripe, Y = Yellow, YB = Yellow with black stripe, L = Blue
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Common internal voltage regulator supplies regulated power to both water temp and oil pressure bimetal gauges.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-54 Circuit diagram for voltmeter and fuel level indicating and fuel level warning system
diagrams.description: Circuit schematic and harness wiring diagram for voltmeter, fuel level gauge, fuel tank sending unit, low fuel warning lamp (floor console), ignition switch, ignition relay, and fuse block.
wiring_and_connections: Color Code: B = Black, BW = Black with white stripe, W = White, WB = White with black stripe, WR = White with red stripe, RW = Red with white stripe, Y = Yellow, YL = Yellow with blue stripe, G = Green, L = Blue
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Low fuel warning lamp thermistor sensor in fuel tank triggers floor console warning lamp when fuel drops below threshold.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-55 Circuit diagram for brake warning system
diagrams.description: Schematic diagram of brake warning system showing alternator IC regulator charging feedback, brake warning lamp check relay, parking brake switch, brake fluid level switch, brake warning lamp, ignition switch, and ignition relay.
measurements_and_specs: Ignition switch continuity matrix: OFF, ACC, ON, ST across B, IG, ST, ACC
wiring_and_connections: Alternator terminals: A (Battery sense/output), S (Stator), L (Lamp/IC regulator), E (Ground)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Warning lamp illuminates during bulb-check in START, or when fluid is low, or when parking brake is set, or if alternator charging output fails via the check relay.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-56 Wiring diagram for brake warning system
diagrams.description: Full-page harness wiring diagram of brake warning system showing physical connector routing between alternator, master cylinder switch, check relay, parking brake switch, cluster lamp, fuse block, and ignition switch.
components: Brake master cylinder (Brake fluid level sw.)
Connectors C-1, C-4, C-5, C-6, C-9
wiring_and_connections: Color Code: B = Black, BW = Black with white stripe, W = White, WB = White with black stripe, WR = White with red stripe, GY = Green with yellow stripe, L = Blue, G = Green, Y = Yellow
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Traces harness paths through C-1, C-4, C-5, C-6, and C-9 junction blocks across firewall and interior floor.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-57 Circuit diagram for charge warning lamp
diagrams.description: Circuit schematic and harness wiring diagram for alternator charge warning lamp system showing connections between alternator 'L' terminal, charge warning lamp (in voltage & fuel gauge), fuse block, ignition relay, and ignition switch.
wiring_and_connections: Color Code: B = Black, BW = Black with white stripe, W = White, WB = White with black stripe, WR = White with red stripe, G = Green, L = Blue
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Charge warning lamp is powered from ignition relay and grounded through alternator 'L' terminal when alternator is not charging.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-58 Tachometer
diagrams.description: Rear view of tachometer showing bulb sockets, harness pigtail, 8-pin connector pinout, and dial face (0-8000 RPM).
wiring_and_connections: Connector wire colors: RL, GR, B, L, GW, GB, LB
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Sockets are removed by twisting counterclockwise from the rear casing.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-59 Removing screws
diagrams.description: Sectional profile illustration showing locations of upper retaining screw ① and lower retaining screw ② for cluster meters.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Upper screw accessed from front; lower screw reached from underneath instrument panel.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-60 Removing screw - ①
diagrams.description: Front dashboard view showing screwdriver loosening upper tachometer retaining screw ①.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Use care with screwdriver tip near dial and lens.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-61 Removing screw - ②
diagrams.description: Under-dash view showing screwdriver loosening lower tachometer retaining screw ② at steering shaft bracket.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Work from beneath instrument panel near steering column.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-62 Disconnecting connector
diagrams.description: Pulling tachometer forward out of instrument panel and disconnecting modular wire harness connector.
wiring_and_connections: Modular multipin connector to main dash harness
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Release locking tab on connector before pulling.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-64 Removing reset cable
diagrams.description: Loosening small set screw to disconnect trip meter reset cable through the tachometer opening in the dash.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Access the reset cable through the vacant tachometer hole after tachometer has been removed.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-65 Removing screws
diagrams.description: Side sectional diagram illustrating positions of upper screw ① and lower screw ② holding speedometer in instrument panel.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Identical mounting configuration to the tachometer.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-66 Removing screw - ①
diagrams.description: Front view showing screwdriver loosening upper speedometer retaining screw ①.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Remove through front bezel opening.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-67 Removing screw - ②
diagrams.description: View beneath instrument panel showing screwdriver loosening lower speedometer retaining screw ② near speedometer cable and harness connector.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Reach up from underneath dash behind the steering column.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-63 Speedometer
diagrams.description: Rear view of speedometer with bulb socket callouts, connector pinout (L, RL, GW, R, WB, B, GY, RW), and front dials for U.S.A. (160 mph) and Canada (240 km/h).
wiring_and_connections: Connector wire colors: L, RL, GW, R, WB, B, GY, RW
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Manual transmission speedometer includes speed switch for emissions EFI circuit.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-68 Disconnecting connector
diagrams.description: Disconnecting wiring harness connector from back of speedometer after pulling speedometer forward.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Support the meter body with one hand while depressing the connector release lock.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-70 Removing instrument finisher
diagrams.description: Removing center console/finisher panel containing floor temperature, map lamp, and fuel warning lamp.
wiring_and_connections: Two electrical connectors (three for California models with floor temp lamp)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Pull finisher outward gently to avoid snapping retaining tabs before disconnecting wire plugs.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-71 Removing three-way duct retaining screws
diagrams.description: Removing retaining screws securing three-way ventilation duct behind center dashboard finisher.
measurements_and_specs: Two screws for three-way venti-duct; four screws for bracket
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Remove ventilation duct to expose auxiliary gauge retaining screws.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-72 Removing gauge retaining screws
diagrams.description: Unscrewing spring bracket retaining screw holding auxiliary gauge pod into instrument panel.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Loosen bracket screw and release spring tension to push gauge out from rear.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-69 TEMP-OIL and VOLT-FUEL gauges
diagrams.description: Front faces, spring clamp profile, and rear wiring socket configurations for VOLTS-FUEL and TEMP-OIL dual auxiliary gauges.
wiring_and_connections: VOLT-FUEL gauge: Two connectors (2-pin with RW, B / GW; 6-pin with RL, Y, L / L, G, B)
TEMP-OIL gauge: One 6-pin connector (YB, Y, L / RL, B, GW)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: VOLT-FUEL has two separate connectors; TEMP-OIL has one six-terminal connector.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-73 Oil pressure sending unit
diagrams.description: Location of oil pressure sending unit mounted on engine block beside oil filter mount.
wiring_and_connections: Dual-terminal sender connection (pressure gauge signal and fuel pump safety switch)
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Apply conductive sealer to threads before screwing in new sender; do not overtighten.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-74 Thermal transmitter
diagrams.description: Thermostat housing sensor arrangement showing thermal transmitter, EFI water temperature sensor, and thermotime switch.
components: Water temperature sensor (For Electronic Fuel Injection System)
Thermotime switch (For Electronic Fuel Injection System)

callouts.2: Water temperature sensor (For Electronic Fuel Injection System)
callouts.3: Thermotime switch (For Electronic Fuel Injection System)

wiring_and_connections: Single-wire push-on spade connector for gauge thermal transmitter
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Apply conductive sealer to threads upon installation. Do not confuse gauge sender (1) with EFI sensors (2 and 3).

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-75 Fuel tank gauge unit
diagrams.description: Fuel tank sender unit assembly with float arm, level rheostat, low-fuel thermistor, and terminal plug.

callouts.3: Yellow with blue stripe (YL) Warning Lamp

diagrams.mechanic_notes: Refer to Section FE for fuel tank drop and replacement details.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-76 Fuel warning lamp
diagrams.description: Instrument finisher panel underside and individual fuel warning lamp body with socket and bulb.
wiring_and_connections: Two-wire plug connector to console harness
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Bulb socket twists out from the rear of the individual warning lamp housing.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-77 Parking brake switch
diagrams.description: Parking brake hand lever mechanism showing switch mounted to lever support bracket.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Switch grounds through lever bracket mounting.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-78 Brake warning lamp check relay
diagrams.description: Floor pan layout under front passenger seat showing location of brake warning lamp check relay and floor sensor relay.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Remove four passenger seat mounting bolts to lift out seat for access to floor-mounted relays.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-79 Sectional view of heater
diagrams.description: Cross-sectional flow diagram of heater core housing, blower fan, air intake door, mode door, floor door, and water cock.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Mechanical doors regulate proportion of bypassed ambient air versus air heated through core.

diagrams.caption: Ventilating air flow and heater control setting
diagrams.description: Ventilating mode control lever positions (AIR in VENT) and resulting airflow path from outside air intake through side vents and center vent.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: In VENT position, air completely bypasses heater core and routes directly to dash face outlets.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-80 Air flow
diagrams.description: Schematic diagrams showing heater control lever settings and airflow patterns for BI-LEVEL, Heating, Defrosting, and Not in use (OFF) modes.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: In OFF mode, intake door is completely closed to shut off outside air ingress.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-81 Exploded view of heater
diagrams.description: Exploded assembly view of heater unit, fan blower unit, air intake duct, ducting hoses, and coolant inlet/outlet plumbing.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Drain engine coolant before disconnecting heater core inlet and outlet hoses.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-82 Removing finisher
diagrams.description: Removing center control finisher panel over heater control levers showing warning lamp and map lamp housing.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Disconnect map lamp and warning lamp connectors to free finisher from center console area.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-83 Removing clips
diagrams.description: Demonstration of releasing spring metal casing retaining clip from control cable outer sheath.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Pry spring clip upward to disengage cable sheath without crimping inner wire.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-84 Disconnecting intake door control cable
diagrams.description: Disconnecting control cable eyelet from intake door actuating lever and releasing sheath clamp.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Unhook cable eyelet from lever pin after releasing casing clamp screw/clip.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-85 Disconnecting heater cock control cable
diagrams.description: Disconnecting water cock control cable from water valve arm and casing clamp.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Ensure water cock valve moves freely across full travel prior to cable reconnection.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-86 Disconnecting mode door control rod
diagrams.description: Illustration of disconnecting the mode door control rod from the heater control lever.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Disconnect control rod from operating lever.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-87 Disconnecting floor door control cable
diagrams.description: Illustration showing detachment of floor door control cable from lever and clamp.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Loosen clamp to free the floor door outer cable and disconnect inner wire from lever.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-88 Removing retaining screws
diagrams.description: Under-dash view showing locations of retaining screws securing the heater control assembly to instrument panel reinforcement.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Remove two screws securing control assembly to instrument panel reinforcement.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-89 Removing retaining screws
diagrams.description: Illustration of removing the two screws securing the heater control bracket to the heater unit.
diagrams.mechanic_notes: Remove two screws retaining heater control to heater unit.

diagrams.caption: Fig. BE-90 Removing heater unit

diagrams.description: Schematic and physical circuit diagram for California emission floor temperature warning system. troubleshooting.symptom: Blown fuse or melted fusible link
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Short circuit in power supply or heavy load-carrying circuit
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Systematically trace circuit for shorts or grounding before installing new fuse. Never use higher rating fuse or wrap fusible links in vinyl tape.

troubleshooting.symptom: Poor electrical contact or excessive circuit voltage drop
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Rust, corrosion, or dirt on fuse clips or terminal blades
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Clean metal contact surfaces with fine-grained sandpaper until shiny bare metal contact is made.

troubleshooting.symptom: Glove box lamp stays ON or fails to illuminate
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Inspect continuity: when plunger is pressed in, continuity must not exist; when plunger projects out, continuity must exist.

troubleshooting.symptom: Combination switch failure (lights, wipers, or turn signals inoperative)
troubleshooting.probable_cause: Internal contact wear or loose connector terminal
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Check continuity across designated connector terminal pairs per Fig. BE-41 matrix; check alignment of tab in steering column jacket.

troubleshooting.probable_cause: Contaminated auto-stop relay contacts or improper contact due to foreign matter
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Remove auto-stop device cover, and clean contacts carefully so as not to deform relay plate.

troubleshooting.symptom: Windshield wiper does not stop correctly - Stops anywhere (Cable and switch)

troubleshooting.corrective_action: Remove switch, and make sure that 1st and 2nd steps are not connected at 'OFF' position. If connected, replace switch.

troubleshooting.symptom: Windshield wiper does not stop correctly - Does not stop (Motor)

troubleshooting.corrective_action: Remove auto-stop device cover, and correct relay plate bending.

troubleshooting.symptom: Ignition system: Noise occurs when engine is operated
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Install new high tension cable. Replace a 0.5µF radio condenser of primary side + terminal of ignition coil. (Note: Be careful not to install capacitor to secondary or primary breaker side, otherwise engine operation becomes improper.)

troubleshooting.symptom: Charging system: Sound of alternating current present; When accelerator pedal is depressed or released, noise occurs
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Replace a 0.5µF capacitor to charging terminal B or charge warning terminal L. (Note: Do not use a larger capacitor.)

troubleshooting.symptom: Fuel system: When ignition switch is set to 'ON', noise occurs
troubleshooting.corrective_action: Install a 0.5µF capacitor to power lead connector plug of electric fuel pump.
